✅ Correct Answer: A — Donington's pit lane bypassed the final hairpin and had no speed limit

📖 Explanation:

In 1993, Formula 1 regulations had not yet established a mandatory pit lane speed limit.

Because Donington Park's pit lane cut across the inside of the Goddards hairpin, driving straight through covered a shorter physical distance than staying on the racetrack.

On lap 57, Senna aborted a planned pit stop, drove through the pit lane without stopping, and set the fastest lap of the Grand Prix at 1:18.029.
